categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of in vitro diagnostic reagents, focusing on allergy and autoimmune disease detection. It offers a broad range of products including IgE allergy detection kits, food-specific IgG detection kits, and autoimmune antibody detection kits, along with related diagnostic instruments. The company also develops desensitization drugs for allergy treatment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), enzyme-linked immunosorbent capture assay, and nano-magnetic particle chemiluminescence immunoassay. The company has proprietary antigen and antibody preparation technologies and emphasizes automation and quantitative detection methods. Production follows strict quality management systems compliant with ISO13485 standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are hospitals at various levels, third-party medical testing institutions, and healthcare providers in China. The company also serves international markets including Europe and the Middle East. Its products assist clinical diagnosis and treatment of allergic and autoimmune diseases.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with sales covering over 30 provinces. It has subsidiaries and operations in the United States and Singapore, and is expanding its international presence in Europe, the Middle East, South Asia, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on reagent and diagnostic instrument manufacturing and sales. It also engages in upstream activities by producing core raw materials such as recombinant antigens and monoclonal antibodies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the product menu for allergy and autoimmune diagnostics, advancing nano-magnetic chemiluminescence technology, and developing fully automated, high-throughput diagnostic instruments. The company invests heavily in R&D to enhance quantitative detection capabilities and to achieve import substitution. It also pursues clinical research and regulatory approvals for new desensitization drugs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of diagnostic reagents and instruments. The company uses a sales model dominated by distributors with supplementary direct sales to end customers. It also earns income from licensing and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include international leaders such as Thermo Fisher's Phadia, EUROIMMUN, and domestic companies like Shenzhen Yahui Long. The company holds a leading position domestically in allergy and autoimmune diagnostic reagents, especially in quantitative chemiluminescence products, and is actively expanding its international market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 402 million, a 2.01% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 36.8 million, a 22.24% decrease due to increased investment in new business areas. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of about 11.5% of revenue and has expanded production capacity with new facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes a comprehensive and rich product menu covering a wide range of allergens and autoimmune markers, with advanced quantitative and automated detection technologies. Its proprietary nano-magnetic chemiluminescence technology offers higher sensitivity, specificity, and throughput compared to traditional methods. The company also integrates diagnostic and therapeutic solutions, such as its desensitization drug portfolio, to provide a full-cycle allergy management service.
